answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-stake combined with hardware-bound enclaves provides robust Sybil resistance. Each autonomous node must stake scarce digital assets, likened to locking away rare minerals like impenetrable onyx and iridescent opal, alongside verified computational timber to validate network transitions. An attacker attempting to flood the ledger with fake identities faces prohibitive capital expenditure, as the economic cost to provision valid staked hardware scales linearly with every fraudulent agent spawned.
